meta.source: Style reference extracted from ventriloc.ca/en (tokens.json, variables.css, theme.css, DESIGN.md supplied by the user)

tokens.name: color-graphite
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, nav links, icon strokes, primary button fill. 14:1 or better on every surface (canvas-white, ash, fog, ivory).

tokens.name: color-steel
tokens.usage: Secondary body text and long-form paragraphs. Passes 4.5:1 on canvas-white (8.5), ash (7.4), fog (7.8) and ivory (6.8).

tokens.name: color-slate
tokens.usage: Muted helper text, tertiary nav items, language toggle, footer utility links, inactive controls. Source value kept exact: 3.8:1 on canvas-white and 3.3:1 on ash — below 4.5:1, so use only at 24px+, for non-essential metadata, or switch to color-steel when legibility matters.

tokens.name: color-ember-orange
tokens.usage: The one accent: link underlines, primary chart lines, small icon accents, emphasised short phrases on graphite. Never a button fill. As text it is only 2.9:1 on canvas-white — on light grounds use it as an underline or stroke, not as the text colour itself (5.6:1 on graphite is fine).

tokens.name: color-brass
tokens.usage: Secondary warm accent: chart strokes, decorative SVG lines, tag text, small captions such as the partner-strip label. 5.4:1 on canvas-white, 4.7:1 on ash, 4.9:1 on fog; only 4.3:1 on ivory, so keep brass text off ivory below 24px.

tokens.name: color-canvas-white
tokens.usage: Page background, data-card surface, text on graphite fills.

tokens.name: color-ash
tokens.usage: Dominant warm-gray surface: feature cards, alternating section bands, nav pill container.

tokens.name: color-fog
tokens.usage: Nested containers and secondary backgrounds inside white or ash areas.

tokens.name: color-ivory
tokens.usage: Warm paper wash for featured or editorial blocks. Use sparingly — one ivory block per page at most.

tokens.name: color-mist
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules, chart gridlines, nav background fills.

tokens.name: surface-page-canvas
tokens.usage: Surface level 0 — the page itself.

tokens.name: surface-ash-surface
tokens.usage: Surface level 1 — card and section panels.

tokens.name: surface-fog-surface
tokens.usage: Surface level 2 — nested containers.

tokens.name: surface-ivory-surface
tokens.usage: Surface level 3 — warm accent wash for featured blocks.

families.polysans: "PolySans", "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page. Never bold.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: From raw data to clear reporting

styles.name: label-display
styles.usage: Button labels, nav items, language toggle — the tight 1.0 leading is deliberate.

styles.name: label-display-relaxed
styles.usage: Nav dropdown items and multi-line display labels.

styles.name: micro-display
styles.usage: Chart axis labels and tiny display tags.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We turn scattered spreadsheets into one reliable source of truth.
styles.usage: Hero and section intro paragraphs, in color-steel.

styles.name: lead-medium
styles.sample: Three weeks from kickoff to first dashboard.
styles.usage: Emphasised intro lines and stat labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each report is reviewed against the source before it ships.

styles.name: body-compact
styles.usage: Card body text and list items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small UI labels and stat names.

styles.name: small-tight
styles.usage: Inline chart values and dense metadata.

tokens.name: spacing-unit
tokens.usage: Base unit; every step is a multiple of it.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, chevron to nav text, nav pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Small stacks inside cards: title to value.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing and mobile page gutters.

tokens.name: spacing-20
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding and inline gaps between nav items and logos.

tokens.name: spacing-36
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline block and its body.

tokens.name: spacing-40
tokens.usage: Data-card internal padding.

tokens.name: spacing-60
tokens.usage: Feature-card left padding.

tokens.name: spacing-140
tokens.usage: Hero top padding and the largest editorial breathing room.

tokens.name: page-max-width
tokens.usage: Centered content container width.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical space between sections — sections are separated by whitespace and surface bands, never lines.

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Default card padding.

tokens.name: element-gap
tokens.usage: Default gap between sibling elements in a row or grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inline elements such as inputs and checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard cards (same as radius-cards).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large media containers.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Data-dashboard cards and tags.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill shapes (same as radius-nav-pills).

tokens.name: radius-buttons
tokens.usage: Every button — square edges are deliberate contrast to rounded surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-cards
tokens.usage: Generic content cards.

tokens.name: radius-tags
tokens.usage: Tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-nav-pills
tokens.usage: The floating navigation capsule.

tokens.name: radius-asymmetric-card
tokens.usage: The signature feature-card corner: apply to the TOP-LEFT corner only (border-radius: var(--radius-asymmetric-card) 0 0); every other corner stays square.

shadow.note: The system is flat: depth comes from surface contrast, never elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons and the nav pill. Do not add shadows.
